# Header/footer content controls

Original OPC/XML generated by tools/story_control_fixture.py from our original page-story fixture (tools/page_story_fixtures.py). No external document content or renderer is redistributed. The plain/wrapped pair contains first/even/default headers and footers, nested persistent locked block controls, a building-block gallery wrapper, and inline controls containing a complete PAGE field with stale result 99.

The reference application exported both files without saving them. All three PDF pages are pixel-identical between variants at 96 DPI; page text confirms fields resolve to 1/2/3 rather than cached 99. reference.json records source/PDF hashes and text. Browser tests compare all three rendered pages, assert six displayed story/page-number strings and verify identical uncompressed package entries. Both variants now permit body editing while preserving the original header/footer controls. Tests cover edited exports, untouched story XML, exact undo and reopen; direct control or header/footer editing remains unsupported.
